newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: European envoy to bolster peace in Guatemala.
newsitem.headline: European envoy to bolster peace in Guatemala.

text.p: The vice president of the European Community arrived in Guatemala on Thursday, aiming to strengthen international support for the peace process there, officials said.

Manuel Marin of Spain will meet on Friday with Guatemalan President Alvaro Arzu, government ministers, ambassadors from countries in the European Community and the press, the Guatemalan Minstry of Foreign Relations said.

The international community as a whole has promised $1.9 billion in loans, gifts and technical assistance to support a historic peace agreement between the government and the rebels on Dec. 29 which ended 36 years of civil war.
